summary: Verified Security Officer column border-visibility fix on Dispatch Schedule page. Officer cells and header now render with indigo-400 (rgb(129,140,248)) border color which is clearly visible against the light-indigo (#E0E7FF / rgb(224,231,255)) cell background and stands out from neighboring cells' default gray (rgb(226,232,240)) borders. No regressions detected in Column Chooser, Export CSV button, sticky Date column, shift row tinting, or status pills.

verification_details.cascade_verified: border-indigo-400 class concatenated AFTER border-[#E2E8F0] wins in Tailwind cascade

critical_code_review_comments: The border width for top/left on officer cells is 0px because the table uses only border-r + border-b (grid pattern). Visually this still yields a complete 4-side indigo outline because adjacent officer cells/header supply the top/left edges. This is correct and matches other columns' grid style.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified via getComputedStyle and screenshot. Officer column shows visible indigo border on both header and data cells, neighbors unaffected.
